description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing E1AP procedures in a 3GPP telecommunications context, including connection management, bearer context handling, notifications, and statistics within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: e1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing E1AP connection procedures such as reset and setup responses.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_manager
classes.description: Interface for handling bearer context procedures including setup, modification, and release.

classes.name: bearer_creation_complete_message
classes.description: Struct containing UE index indicating bearer creation completion.

classes.name: e1ap_common_cu_up_task_notifier
classes.description: Interface for scheduling E1AP async tasks using common signaling.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_processor_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP processor about E1AP events.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_removal_handler
classes.description: Interface for removing bearer contexts of UEs.

classes.name: e1ap_ngap_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying NGAP about E1 setup requests.

classes.name: e1ap_ue_handler
classes.description: Interface for updating and canceling UE contexts.

classes.name: e1ap_statistics_handler
classes.description: Interface for querying E1AP statistics such as number of UEs.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_cp
classes.description: Main interface class combining all E1AP handling functionalities for CU-CP.

methods.name: get_e1ap_bearer_context_manager
methods.description: Returns the bearer context manager interface.

methods.name: get_e1ap_bearer_context_removal_handler
methods.description: Returns the bearer context removal handler interface.
